limitations.note: The combinational decode fixes the one-cycle delay, but drops the explicit reset override and propagates unknown state bits to the outputs instead of defaulting both outputs to zero.
The reset check waits for the FSM state to settle before checking the outputs, so it passes even without the explicit reset override and never checks the unknown-state default.
